name: Spurlock Custom Woodworks
old_description: At Spurlock Custom Woodworks LLC, we specialize in designing and building custom, made-to-order furniture that perfectly fits your style and space. Discover the beauty of handcrafted pieces made from premium hardwoods like Walnut, Oak, and Cherry.
about:
Spurlock Custom Woodworks LLC operates from Little Rock, Arkansas, where it designs and builds custom, made-to-order furniture. The company’s founding year and ownership structure have not been publicly disclosed.

The workshop produces handcrafted furniture pieces using premium hardwoods such as walnut, oak, and cherry. Its product range includes bedroom sets — bed frames, dressers, and nightstands — as well as bespoke cabinetry and living room essentials. Each item is built to order, with an emphasis on precision joinery and durable construction. The company operates from a facility on Morrison Road in Little Rock, maintaining weekday and Saturday hours for client appointments. Customers initiate projects through an online request form.

The company serves residential clients seeking tailored furniture for private homes. Projects referenced on its site include custom bedroom suites and built-in cabinetry for individual homeowners. Contact is handled directly by Greg via email or phone, with no minimum order quantity published. The firm also maintains a presence on Facebook and Instagram.

Spurlock Custom Woodworks highlights its commitment to superior craftsmanship, functionality, and timeless design as the foundation of its work. The firm states that every piece is constructed with precision and care using only select hardwoods to ensure longevity.
